python.package: Z-score and statistical calculations - already available via sentence-transformers
pearsonr correlation detection - already in dependencies via prophet
Model definitions for Trend, TrendAnalysisResult, CorrelationResult

interface.name: analyze_trends
interface.signature: async def analyze_trends(metrics: List[str], timeseries_data: Dict[str, TimeSeriesData]) -> TrendAnalysisResult

interface.name: detect_correlations
interface.signature: def detect_correlations(metric_a: str, metric_b: str, values_a: List[float], values_b: List[float]) -> CorrelationResult

interface.name: calculate_cagr
interface.signature: def calculate_cagr(start_value: float, end_value: float, years: float) -> float

interface.name: TrendDirection
interface.signature: class TrendDirection(str, Enum): INCREASING, DECREASING, STABLE, CYCLICAL

interface.name: Trend
interface.signature: class Trend(BaseModel): metric, direction, magnitude, confidence, start_date, end_date, description, cagr, qoq_growth

interface.name: TrendAnalysisResult
interface.signature: class TrendAnalysisResult(BaseModel): trends, correlations, metrics_analyzed, analysis_method

interface.name: CorrelationResult
interface.signature: class CorrelationResult(BaseModel): metric_a, metric_b, correlation_coefficient, p_value, interpretation

constraints.constraint: Google-style docstrings for all public functions
~50-80 lines in trends.py (comprehensive docstrings acceptable per Story 4.5)
Use structured logging with extra={} context
No new dependencies - scipy.stats.pearsonr already available
Unit tests mock external dependencies (Mistral client)
Direction classification: >5% = INCREASING, <-5% = DECREASING, else STABLE

tests.standards: Per docs/process/definition-of-done.md and docs/architecture/testing-strategy.md: - New code must have >=80% test coverage - Unit tests mock external dependencies (Mistral client, scipy stats) - Integration tests use test database (port 6335/5433 per Story 4.0.5) - Synthetic test data with known trends for accuracy validation - Follow Story 4.5 test patterns (30 unit + 13 integration = 43 tests)
